The learned counsel for the respondent no. 9 also supports the aforesaid fact and he submits that if the petitioner is ready to get married to the victim girl, he has no objection if the Patna High Court CR. WJC No.1994 of 2025(2) dt.19-12-2025 petitioner is granted privilege of provisional bail for marrying the victim girl.

5. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, this Court directs that the petitioner, above named, be released on Provisional bail for a period of Six weeks from today to solemnize the marriage with the victim girl on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned concerned Court below in connection with Turkaulia P.S. Case No. 673 of 2022.

6. Re-list this case on 02.02.2026.
7.
The petitioner will file a joint supplementary affidavit after getting married to the victim girl before the next date of hearing.

opennyai_summary.facts:
1 2. The instant writ petition has been filed for the following relief(s):-
a.
For issuance of a direction to the Learned Court below to record a compromised in POCSO Trial No.98 of 2023, arising out of Turkauliya P.S. Case No. 673 of 2022,
lodged on 12.07.2022, under Sections 363/366/376/504/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 4 of the POCSO Act, with the help of well-wishers and family member both sides have agreed to inter into marital relationship as both have attended majority;
b.
For issuance of a direction or order for release the petitioner on bail for pursuance of marriage with Respondent No. 2;
c. For staying the proceedings before the Learned Court below in the instant matter during the pending of this application.
3. Though the petitioner is accused of committing rape with a minor girl but the learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner and the victim were in a relationship and now the petitioner wants to marry the victim girl i.e., the respondent no. 9.
